title: 第17章 体修年终发灵石了第18章 残酷与温情
content_zh:
第17章体修，年终发灵石了
“姜师兄，我只是死记硬背，要想使用出这些招式，恐怕还要苦练。”
林浩笑了笑道，记住动作是一回事，但能用身体施展出来，就有些难度。
“已经很不错了。”
姜胜压下心中的惊讶，见他记忆好，反而开心起来。
因为这样他教起来，就轻松很多，不用耽误太多自己修炼的时间。
他犹豫片刻，从身上取出一张画着人体图案的羊皮卷，道：“这是崩山拳招式相对应的灵气运转经脉图，和拳法使用要点，林师弟你记下后，再把这经脉图还给我。”
“嗯，谢谢姜师兄。”
林浩点头道谢，心情有些激动的接过他递来的羊皮卷。
“林师弟，我先修炼了。”
姜胜有些古道热肠的道：“你如果有什么不懂的，等我修炼结束，你可以问我。”
说完，他便盘膝而坐，运转玄岳炼气诀抓紧时间修炼起来。
姜胜来到玄岳宗已经两年，留给他成为外门弟子的时间，只剩下一年，必须争分夺秒。
见三人都进入修炼状态，林浩在洞中一处地方坐下，打开羊皮卷认真看了起来。
羊皮卷展开之后，长约两尺多，上面有十二幅经脉图，对应十二个招式，还有详细的文字讲解。
林浩花了一些时间，把羊皮卷上面的全部内容记下后，他脸上浮现出惊喜的笑容。
这崩山拳是体修拳法，不仅可用于战斗，平时练习，还能锤炼身体上的肌肉，使肉身变强。
不过，在羊皮卷上有一行醒目的红字警示修炼者，每天若是练习此拳次数太多，胃口会变得极大，必须吃很多肉食或者配合血气类的药膳和丹药，来补充肉身潜能，否则肉身根本扛不住。
并且练到一定程度，吃普通的肉都不行，需要吃珍贵的妖兽肉。
体修，不愧是出名的烧钱，修炼需要配合药膳，丹药，妖兽肉，家底不厚的人，选择走炼体的路子，根本撑不住。

只苦练，而不补，身体迟早废掉。
林浩怔怔的看着羊皮卷对于体修的介绍，有些咂舌。
他听说过体修战斗力极强，心中很是向往，但看到炼体所需的资源，他就感觉到一股无形的压力。
“现在先把这崩山拳学会，用来提升实力。
至于后面要走炼体的路子，也不是不可以。
我有可以提升灵药，丹药和法宝这些东西品质的万古长生塔。”
林浩心中暗暗想道：“到时候我把提升品质后的丹药和法宝等东西卖掉，赚取差价，用赚到的灵石，来购买炼体所需的物资就行了。”
想到这里，他觉得甚是可行，不禁兴奋起来。
体修战斗力在同境界中极强，遇到危险活下来的几率，比不炼体的修士高很多，比较怕死的林浩准备后面法体双修。
他在脑海中遐想了一下未来，便把羊皮卷收好。
林浩站起身来，怕练拳的动静太大，影响到洞中其他三人修炼，他犹豫了下，往接近山洞出口的地方走了一段距离，才摆出身形练习起拳法。
林浩调用体内灵气，按照羊皮卷记载的方法，流入特定的经脉中，不断使用出崩山拳招式。
靠着不错的记忆力，他大概练习了半个时辰，便已经勉强掌握崩山拳，达到入门的程度。
林浩浑身都是汗水感觉身上肌肉在发烫，甚至微微有些颤抖，这是肉身遭受到锤炼的表现。
第17章体修，年终发灵石了
又过了会，他收拳而立，缓缓吐出一口浊气。
今日林浩修炼崩山拳的时间已经差不多足够，他现在没有妖兽肉，药膳，丹药之类的东西，来补充身体，若是再练习就会伤身。
content_en:
Chapter 17: Physical training, spiritual stones are issued at the end of the year
"Senior Brother Jiang, I'm just memorizing them by rote. If I want to use these moves, I'm afraid I have to practice hard."
Lin Hao smiled and said, "It's one thing to remember the movements, but it's a little difficult to execute them with your body."
"It's already pretty good."
Jiang Sheng suppressed the surprise in his heart and became happy when he saw that his memory was good.
Because this makes it much easier for him to teach, and he doesn't have to waste too much time on his own cultivation.
He hesitated for a moment, then took out a parchment scroll with a human body pattern on it, and said: "This is the meridian diagram of the spiritual energy movement corresponding to the Bengshan Fist moves, as well as the key points of the boxing technique. Junior Brother Lin, please write it down and then return this meridian diagram to me."
"Well, thank you, Senior Brother Jiang."
Lin Hao nodded and thanked him, and took the parchment he handed him with some excitement.
"Junior Brother Lin, I'm going to practice first."
Jiang Sheng said warmly, "If you don't understand anything, you can ask me after I finish practicing."
After saying that, he sat cross-legged and started practicing the Xuanyue Qi Refining Technique as soon as possible.
It has been two years since Jiang Sheng came to Xuanyue Sect, and he only had one year left to become an outer disciple, so he had to race against time.
Seeing that the three of them had entered a state of cultivation, Lin Hao sat down somewhere in the cave, opened the parchment and read it carefully.
After the parchment is unfolded, it is about two feet long. There are twelve meridian diagrams on it, corresponding to twelve moves, as well as detailed text explanations.
Lin Hao spent some time writing down all the contents on the parchment, and a surprised smile appeared on his face.
This Bengshan Boxing is a body-building boxing method. It can not only be used in battles and daily practice, but can also strengthen the muscles of the body and make the body stronger.
However, there is a line of eye-catching red letters on the parchment scroll warning practitioners that if they practice this boxing too many times every day, their appetite will become extremely large, and they must eat a lot of meat or combine blood and gas medicines and elixirs to replenish their physical body's potential, otherwise the physical body will not be able to bear it at all.
And after practicing to a certain level, you can't even eat ordinary meat. You need to eat precious monster meat.
Physical training is notoriously expensive. It requires a combination of medicated diet, elixirs, and monster meat. People with poor family backgrounds will not be able to survive if they choose to take the path of physical training.
If you just train hard without nourishing your body, your body will become useless sooner or later.
Lin Hao stared blankly at the parchment's introduction to physical training, and was speechless.
He had heard that physical training was extremely powerful in combat, and he yearned for it, but when he saw the resources required for physical training, he felt an invisible pressure.
“Now let’s learn the Bengshan Fist and use it to improve our strength.
As for taking the path of body training in the future, it is not impossible.
I have an eternal tower that can improve the quality of elixirs, elixirs and magic weapons. "
Lin Hao secretly thought in his heart: "When the time comes, I will sell the improved elixirs, magic weapons and other items, earn the difference, and use the earned spiritual stones to purchase the materials needed for body refining."
Thinking of this, he felt that it was very feasible and couldn't help but get excited.
The combat effectiveness of physical training is extremely strong in the same realm, and the chance of surviving in danger is much higher than that of monks who do not practice physical training. Lin Hao, who is more afraid of death, is preparing to practice both legal and physical training later.
He thought about the future in his mind and put the parchment away.
Lin Hao stood up. He was afraid that the movement of the boxing practice would be too loud and affect the practice of the other three people in the cave. He hesitated for a moment and walked some distance closer to the cave exit before posing and practicing the boxing technique.
Lin Hao called on the spiritual energy in his body, flowed it into specific meridians according to the method recorded in the parchment scroll, and continued to use Bengshan Fist moves.
Relying on his good memory, he had barely mastered Bengshan Fist after practicing it for about half an hour, reaching an introductory level.
Lin Hao was covered in sweat and felt that the muscles on his body were hot and even trembling slightly. This was a sign that his physical body had been tempered.
Chapter 17: Physical training, spiritual stones are issued at the end of the year
After a while, he stood up with his fists closed, and slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.
Today, Lin Hao has almost enough time to practice Bengshan Fist. He does not have monster meat, medicinal food, pills or other things to replenish his body. If he practices any more, he will hurt his body.
